queue.what: Italy's national postal and parcel operator, which sends U.S.-bound parcels and offers Poste Delivery International Express for U.S. shipments.
Austria's national postal and logistics operator, which ships parcels to the U.S. including Puerto Rico and offers the Post Express International product for U.S. shipments.
Nordic postal and logistics group (Sweden and Denmark) that sends U.S.-bound commercial parcels.
Switzerland's national postal operator, which provides international parcel and express delivery including U.S.-bound postal goods consignments.
